correctness.rationale: For real signals, exact coarea and the triangle inequality reduce to binary cuts. A run-count majorization lemma selects a contiguous rim arc at each cardinality, with all boundaries handled. Its four-value rim histogram gives exact rational formulas and a 29-rim crossover; positive doubly stochastic centering proves strict contraction, and singleton lower plus centering upper bounds squeeze the limit. Full exact checks from the actual companion script corroborate the derivation; no extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The theorem replaces 2^m cut candidates with an exact O(m) rational scan on a canonical irregular-degree graph, identifies a sharp structural 29-vertex-rim crossover between two natural contraction geometries, and proves that the sharp Gini coefficient crosses its oscillation counterpart yet converges to it asymptotically. This explains a substantive stability distinction and supplies a reusable majorization lemma.
